title: Why Your Cold Emails Get No Replies (And How To Fix It)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

speakers.name: Lindsay
speakers.role: co-host, works with AI automation agency founders

speakers.name: Will Cannon
speakers.role: guest, founder of UpLead and other software businesses

promo_conflict: Guest is founder of UpLead and promotes it and his cold email services/playbooks

idea.name: UpLead: affordable B2B data tool sold via cold email
idea.one_liner: B2B contact data platform positioned as a cheaper ZoomInfo with real-time email verification and intent signals, grown to $1M ARR almost entirely with short cold email sequences offering 50 free leads
idea.customer: SaaS and IT companies with 50-500 employees and sales teams
idea.offer: B2B contact data with real-time verification and buyer-intent signals
idea.revenue_model: SaaS subscription after free trial leads

key_quotes.quote: We got probably to our first 1 million AR almost entirely through cold email.
It's like zoom info but with real-time email verification and we're really afford.
And the other one was, can I send you 50 free leads?

claims.claim: Reached ~$1M ARR almost entirely via cold email
claims.quote: We got probably to our first 1 million AR almost entirely through cold email.

claims.claim: 75%+ of cold email revenue comes after the first email
claims.quote: We found that 80 75 plus percent of the revenue we generate from cold email is not from the first email.

claims.claim: Sends ~40-50K cold emails per month across 200-400 domains
claims.quote: >> We're sending right now about I think 40 or 50,000 per month.

acquisition_channels.details: 10-15 email sequences over 30-60 days; competitor-reference pitch; free-leads CTA; intent/trigger-based lists

ideas.delivery: self-serve SaaS app with free trial leads
ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR permits B2B cold email to corporate subscribers but not sole traders/partnerships without consent; UK GDPR applies to B2B contact data resale

idea.name: Financial planner cold-emailing teachers via district relationship
idea.one_liner: Certified financial planner cold emails teachers in school districts his firm has a relationship with, offering to take over their accounts; under-targeted segment books ~5 meetings/day
idea.offer: financial planning and moving retirement accounts

key_quotes.quote: So, I have a friend that's a certified financial planner and he's crushing it on cold emails in a very specific way.
So, he's sending messages in a specific way because he has a specific relationship and he's getting um his cold email campaign like he's booking like five meetings a day.

claims.claim: Books about five meetings a day, ~100/month
claims.quote: >> and I mean he's sending weekends too, but let's we're going to you know we're going to call it 100 meetings a monthish plus, right?

acquisition_channels.details: personalised emails referencing school district relationship

uk_legal_risk.reason: Cold marketing email to individual employees' personal addresses needs consent under PECR

ideas.other_uk_rules: FCA authorisation required for financial advice; financial promotions rules

idea.name: AI automation agency for SMBs
idea.one_liner: Agency that charges $2-5K upfront to audit/solve an SMB problem with AI plus ongoing monthly maintenance, acquired via narrowly-targeted ICP cold email
idea.offer: AI audit, automation build and maintenance

key_quotes.quote: >> So I work with like over 100 people right now that are trying to start AI automation agencies.
There's 400 million small business owners in the world.

prices: a couple hundred dollars per month

ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR: no cold email to sole traders without consent

idea.name: White-label HighLevel job tracker for auto body shops
idea.one_liner: White-labelled GoHighLevel software letting collision repair customers check repair status, sold only to body shops doing $40K+/month, expanded from Georgia to nationwide
idea.customer: auto body and collision repair shops with $40K+/month revenue

key_quotes.quote: Well, for example, one of the guys that I know, he sells basically a tracking system for auto body and collision repair shops that have over $40,000 in revenue per month.
He's just selling white labelled high level but like that is his ICP auto body collision repair places $40,000 a month at least in revenue that one product and he's crushing it >> nationwide.

acquisition_channels.details: suggested by guest as an untapped channel

idea.name: Done-for-you YouTube production agency with free first month
idea.one_liner: Flat-fee agency writing scripts, editing and making thumbnails for new YouTubers, closing via cold email offering one month free

key_quotes.quote: I had someone reach out to me and said, "We're a done for you email agency.
And if it works and if if you get a better um more views and more clicks and more everything from your vid from the videos that we do, then we'll talk about the price.

acquisition_channels.details: personalised pitch with case studies and free month

idea.name: Mortgage industry recruiting via mass cold email
idea.one_liner: Recruiting business for the loan industry that cold-emailed a list of ~1M loan officers, realtors and processors at 5M+ emails a month

key_quotes.quote: So there was probably a few years when I was doing cold email for loan stuff where I was cold emailing, you know, I don't know, five plus million emails a month.

uk_legal_risk.reason: Bulk cold email to individual realtors/loan officers (often sole traders) needs PECR consent
